requirement: Collect a full list of requirements for the NFL decision system.
acceptance: Every requirement has an ID, an acceptance criterion, and a status on the Requirements page.

requirement: Organise and analyse the requirement set into categories.
acceptance: Requirements are grouped by category and each category shows a count and a completion ratio.

requirement: Review the repository line by line and flag irregularities.
acceptance: Every tracked file is listed with its size, its commit link, and an irregularity verdict.

requirement: Every table row carries a link to an official source.
acceptance: Each row in every data table renders a source link; rows without one are marked unverified.

requirement: Values that cannot be confirmed from an official source are left blank and flagged.
acceptance: Blank cells render as UNVERIFIED and are mirrored to the Flagged for Review page.

requirement: No value is inferred, interpolated or recalled from memory.
acceptance: Site footer states the rule; model output is visually separated from fact tables.

requirement: Publish a GitHub Pages site with a clean landing page and category sub-pages.
acceptance: Site builds, has a landing dashboard, and every sub-page is reachable from the nav.

requirement: UI is simple, clean, and dashboard-like with all findings in readable tables.
acceptance: Single CSS theme, one table component, filters and sort on every data table.

requirement: Originate our own NFL lines rather than consume market lines.
acceptance: A documented, reproducible rating-to-line pipeline exists and outputs a number per game.

requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate actionable signals.
acceptance: Strategy register exists with defined inputs, output, and a validation plan per strategy.

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays, and player-prop combinations.
acceptance: At least one strategy is registered in each of the three bet-construction families.

requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates before capital is risked.
acceptance: Gate register exists with explicit thresholds and a pass/fail/blocked state per strategy.

requirement: Determine correlation values between strategy legs and between strategies.
acceptance: Correlation register with an estimator, a required dataset, and a status per pair.

requirement: Remove luck: separate skill from variance before trusting a result.
acceptance: Null-hypothesis test + multiplicity control + minimum-sample gate defined per strategy.

requirement: Run it as a leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies.
acceptance: Leaderboard scoring spec, reward tiers, and anti-gaming rules are published.

requirement: Track injuries league-wide.
acceptance: Official Week 10 injury report is ingested row by row with player, position, practice and game status.

requirement: Know defensive deficiencies created by 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replacing starters.
acceptance: Depth chart is joined to injury status; starter-absent positions produce a named replacement and a depth-of-replacement score.

requirement: Same for offenses: know whether a starter or a backup is playing.
acceptance: Same pipeline is run over offensive position groups.

requirement: Produce an executive summary of the important details.
acceptance: Landing page opens with an executive summary block.

requirement: Create a dedicated suggestions section so a reviewer can pick a path before changes ship.
acceptance: Suggestions page exposes options, trade-offs, and an explicit approve/defer control per suggestion.

requirement: Publish a clear list of open questions: what we know, what we do not know, and how to find out.
acceptance: Questions register splits every item into Known / Unknown / How to discover.

requirement: Coordinate parallel agent sessions without conflicts.
acceptance: COORDINATION.md is the shared board; this session claims a file scope before editing.

requirement: Publish flagged irregularities on the site for post-launch review.
acceptance: Flagged for Review page lists every irregularity with its source link.

requirement: No manual input required from the owner.
acceptance: All ingestion, build, and publish steps run from committed scripts.
